title: A Mixtape for the Yearbook
author: Kestrel Zhou
blurb: Vesper Nystrom, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
